question: Can one tool-using general Agent read a host-owned configuration, propose and apply an exact model/context change through validation, continue under a contracted context, use the newly selected model, re-read the effective revision, and finish without direct configuration writes?
baseline: dynamic-config-context-v0 version 1 completed 135 deterministic boundary cases but its optional live case stopped before chat because one model-list response was not JSON. A later diagnostic GET returned HTTP 200 JSON with both frozen model identifiers present. This is a new run, not a retry or overwrite of that failed case.

backend.endpointAndCredential: AETHER_BASE_URL and AETHER_API_KEY from repository .env; exact bytes must be absent from artifacts

minimumEffectiveDifference: Pass only if the five tools occur in exact order with zero policy violations; every chat round independently reparses as strict SSE with one usage event and one DONE marker; reasoning_content is empty under disabled thinking; context contracts from over 1024 to at most 1024 estimated tokens; at least one completed post-change call requests deepseek-v4-flash; the Agent re-reads and finishes with the exact effective revision; and no private value enters artifacts.
stoppingRules: Stop before chat if either frozen model is absent from the single bounded model-list response.
Never retry a chat call, never fall back to non-streaming, and stop at the first HTTP, SSE, reasoning-profile, tool-schema, order, policy, context, or budget failure.
Persist every completed request and raw SSE response before the next logical call.
Do not change prompt, tools, models, budgets, or scoring after observing a response. A failure requires a new experiment version and run identifier.

decisionRules.pass: Retain host-mediated configuration proposals and immutable request snapshots as a product-integration candidate. This does not authorize direct self-write, generic hot reload, or public Module startup.
decisionRules.fail: Preserve the exact first failing boundary and change only that boundary in a new version.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Missing credentials, unavailable endpoint, or model-list transport failure is infrastructure-inconclusive and does not alter deterministic configuration conclusions.

required: round-N.request.json and round-N.response.sse for every completed dispatch
artifacts.privacy: Synthetic prompts, raw strict-SSE provider responses, tool arguments, usage, hashes, and structural results may be stored. Endpoint, credential, authorization header, and request URL may not be stored.

requiredChecks: Reparse each raw SSE response independently and bind it to its saved request.
Require exact tool order, model transition, context contraction, terminal usage and DONE, disabled thinking, and zero policy violations.
Scan every artifact for the exact configured endpoint and credential bytes.

prohibitedClaims: One private-fixture run is not model portability or reliability evidence.
This in-memory host policy is not Dolly product hot reload, durable restart recovery, or configuration schema support.
HTTP or tool-call success without the exact post-change model and revision checks is not a pass.
The public RUNTIME_MODULE_MIGRATION_REQUIRED refusal remains unchanged.
